deviceCode.note: RFC 8628 Device Code flow for headless agent authentication

identity_signing.note: JWS-signed Agent Cards for T3+ trust level (RFC 7515 + RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization)

mutual_tls.note: Available for T4 trust level. Set enabled=true and provide client_cert_path for mutual TLS.

interface_mapping.message/send: AIBP message send via email_smtp (64 message types)
interface_mapping.message/stream: AIBP inbox monitoring via email_imap IDLE
interface_mapping.tasks/get: Pipeline execution status query by task_id
interface_mapping.tasks/pushNotification/set: Configure async notification for long-running operations

grpc_alternative.note: A2A v1.0 supports gRPC as alternative transport. Recommended for high-throughput inter-agent communication.

governance.alignment: Bridge from AIBP to A2A/MCP transport; A2A and MCP follow AAIF/LF governance on their side
